note: The rocket now leaves the rod or rail when its aft-most launch lug or rail button clears the top, not after it has travelled the whole rod: of the 1,069 design files the app is checked against, 418 change, rod-exit speed falls by a median 5.2 % and by up to 61 %, and 425 configurations in 190 files drop below the report's 15 m/s guidance. Transition shoulders and their end caps now carry mass (124 files change; a blank thickness still flies as 0, with a hint and a one-click fill). Saved runs from before the change need a new Launch. New: winds aloft from Open-Meteo, flown as a profile and saved in .ork; a desktop .ork's wind profile now flies. Recovery verdicts follow the 70/90 ft/s tiers; each booster's report row shows its own recovery weight; latitude and longitude show N/S and E/W, and the weather dialog asks before fetching for a likely mirrored longitude; the user guide can be searched and the glossary has A-Z links. Fixed: typed overflows in Batch and the Drag panel, silent restore repairs, and a layout loop live in v0.142.
